body.purpose: Chrome, chat content, labels, inputs — Rethink Sans Variable (ships in phosphor/fonts, OFL).

display.purpose: Empty-state titles and modal headings — Rethink Sans at display weight.

code.purpose: Anything copyable — hex, JSON, model names, timestamps. Victor Mono Variable via --ph-font-mono (font-mono utility; kit's font-code aliases it).

shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: HeroUI popover/modal lift on --ph-overlay ground. The only shadow in the system; no resting chrome shadows.

motion.name: pop-in
motion.purpose: Enter transition for transient surfaces. motion-safe: only.

motion.name: pop-out
motion.purpose: Exit transition; pair with onAnimationEnd to unmount. motion-safe: only.

motion.name: blink
motion.purpose: Streaming cursor inside the assistant bubble.

components.name: User Chat Bubble
components.description: Surface-2 fill, khaki text, squared bottom-right tail — the voice of the user.
components.html: Can you summarize this page's key claims?
components.css: .ds-bubble-user { max-width: 85%; overflow-wrap: anywhere; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 8px 8px 4px 8px; padding: 8px 12px; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; font-family: 'Rethink Sans Variable', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; background: var(--ph-surface-2, #23372b); color: var(--ph-fg, #c1c497); }

components.name: Assistant Chat Bubble
components.description: Surface fill, hairline border, squared bottom-left tail.
components.html: Three claims stand out — first, that the generator owns the palette…
components.css: .ds-bubble-assistant { max-width: 85%; overflow-wrap: anywhere; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 8px 8px 8px 4px; padding: 8px 12px; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; font-family: 'Rethink Sans Variable', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; background: var(--ph-surface, #1a2520); color: var(--ph-fg, #c1c497); border: 1px solid var(--ph-border, #2e3a34); }

components.name: Send Button
components.description: Mint fill, ink icon — the one saturated commit signal.
components.html: <button class="ds-send-btn" aria-label="Send"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="m22 2-7 20-4-9-9-4Z"/><path d="M22 2 11 13"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-send-btn { width: 32px; height: 32px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border-radius: 8px; border: none; background: var(--ph-primary, #2ed5b7); color: var(--ph-primary-fg, #111c18); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms ease; } .ds-send-btn:hover { background: var(--ph-primary-hover, #45e4c5); } .ds-send-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ph-focus, #2ed5b7); outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-send-btn:disabled { opacity: 0.4; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Stop Button
components.html: <button class="ds-stop-btn" aria-label="Stop"><svg width="12" height="12" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor"><rect x="5" y="5" width="14" height="14" rx="2"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-stop-btn { width: 32px; height: 32px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border-radius: 8px; border: none; background: var(--ph-danger, #df8379); color: var(--ph-danger-fg, #111c18); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms ease; } .ds-stop-btn:hover { background: var(--ph-danger-hover, #ee9186); } .ds-stop-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ph-focus, #2ed5b7); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Icon Button (32×32)
components.description: Sage icon at rest; hover lifts to surface-2 with a mint icon; active fills mint.
components.css: .ds-icon-btn { width: 32px; height: 32px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid transparent; background: transparent; color: var(--ph-fg-sage, #a8bfae); cursor: pointer; flex-shrink: 0; transition: background-color 120ms ease, color 120ms ease, border-color 120ms ease; } .ds-icon-btn:hover { background: var(--ph-surface-2, #23372b); color: var(--ph-primary, #2ed5b7); } .ds-icon-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ph-focus, #2ed5b7); outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-icon-btn:active { background: var(--ph-primary, #2ed5b7); color: var(--ph-primary-fg, #111c18); }

components.name: Composer Input
components.description: Surface-2 field with hairline border; focus shifts the border to mint — the border shift is the entire focus signal.
components.css: .ds-composer { border-top: 1px solid var(--ph-border, #2e3a34); background: var(--ph-bg, #111c18); padding: 8px 12px; } .ds-composer-field { display: block; width: 100%; min-height: 52px; resize: none; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--ph-border, #2e3a34); background: var(--ph-field, #23372b); color: var(--ph-fg, #c1c497); padding: 8px 12px; font-size: 14px; font-family: 'Rethink Sans Variable', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-composer-field::placeholder { color: var(--ph-fg-muted, #8ca194); } .ds-composer-field:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--ph-focus, #2ed5b7); }

components.name: Status Dot
components.description: 8px round signal; success green means connected.
components.css: .ds-status-row { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; } .ds-status-dot { height: 8px; width: 8px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--ph-success, #63b07a); flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-status-label { font-size: 12px; color: var(--ph-fg-muted, #8ca194); font-family: 'Rethink Sans Variable', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; }

components.name: Code Surface
components.description: Sunken ground + hairline border, Victor Mono, mint links — background, foreground, and border travel together.
components.css: .ds-code-surface { background: var(--ph-bg-sunken, #0b1512); color: var(--ph-fg, #c1c497); border: 1px solid var(--ph-border, #2e3a34); border-radius: 8px; padding: 12px; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.4; font-family: 'Victor Mono Variable', ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace; margin: 0; overflow-x: auto; }

narrative.overview: A matte instrument panel: phosphor-black ground, golden-khaki text, one mint signal. Dark by default with a bone-paper light twin. The palette is generated from OKLCH in phosphor/build/palette.py with every contrast pair WCAG-gated at build time; generated CSS is never hand-edited. Component tokens alias --ph-* roles via @theme inline so nested .light scopes re-resolve.
keyCharacteristics: Matte, not glossy: chroma capped ~0.11 except the mint primary; no glows or halo shadows.
Hairline structure: 1px --ph-border separates regions; elevation is tonal, not shadow.
Golden-khaki body text on ink-green grounds; mint is the one hot signal.
Mauve reserved for italic commentary; status roles are closed (success/warning/info/danger).
Dark-first with an opt-in light twin via .light / [data-theme="light"].

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Mint is the only high-chroma color; everything else is matte. A second accent means the palette build was bypassed.

rules.name: The Generator Rule
rules.body: Palette values live in phosphor/build/palette.py. Generated files are never hand-edited.

rules.name: The Twin Rule
rules.body: Every role has a dark and light value. A component that hardcodes a hex breaks the light twin.

rules.name: The 11px Floor Rule
rules.body: No functional text below 11px. Micro-copy that can't fit gets restructured, not shrunk.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Structure is 1px --ph-border. Reach for a hairline, never a glow.

dos: Do express every color as a --ph-* role; component tokens alias roles via @theme inline.
Do edit phosphor/build/palette.py and regenerate for palette changes; never hand-edit generated CSS.
Do keep mint for commit/focus/active semantics and sage for status/links.
Do verify the light twin renders when touching surfaces.
Do use HeroUI Popover/Modal for any floating surface.
donts: Don't hand-edit phosphor/*.css or tokens.json — generated.
Don't add Tailwind color-family utilities (slate-*, teal-*, rose-*) in kit call sites.
Don't add glows, orbs, ambient gradients, or halo rings.
Don't add literal hex in components.
Don't stack bespoke fixed inset-0 overlays or z-index hacks.
Don't let mauve become structural; italic commentary only.
